g.text: Capital cost and 30-year lifecycle cost (PV, 3% real) by option - central estimate, bars show low-high range

All values Estimated (AACE Class 5, -50%/+100%): quantities from conceptual sections, rates = Alberta Transportation 2026 unit price averages x regional factor (Kashechewan 1.5-2.5x), + markups, engineering, 30-50% contingency.
No site survey. Land, relocation and taxes not priced. Source: Construction_Cost_Workbook.xlsx; Source_Register.csv.
